account:
Today I attended my morning office appointment and visited the mill for the scheduled grain inspection. I saw 128 hay bales offered at two emeralds each, equivalent to 1,152 wheat, but have not established who manages the mill or checked storage and deliveries. The secretary is trying to identify the keeper and arrange follow-up. I am now home for my noon lunch, with council letters at one and tea with the neighbour at three still scheduled.

The unusual news is a repeated, vague report of a 'bridge or port change' discussed at the bakery. Townsfolk name baker, freight, and neighbour as present, but I did not witness their discussion and do not know its contents or purpose. Reports of the baker carrying bread and wheat are consistent with ordinary bakery business and do not establish wrongdoing. Repetition of the same rumour is not independent confirmation.

There may be a discussion about transport, deliveries, or public works, but that remains speculation. I previously instructed builder to inspect the bridge and street lighting and submit defects and an itemized estimate; I authorized no paid repairs or purchases. I do not know whether the bakery discussion is related. I asked secretary to seek clarification directly from baker and bring me the answers. I want to learn whether any actual proposal or change exists, who is organizing it, and why, without treating an unverified report as a secret scheme.
